# Fixture provenance

sample.iso is an original REAzip test fixture generated with pycdlib 1.14.0. It contains only SAMPLE.TXT with the exact bytes `REAzip full engine ISO fixture\n`. It contains no third-party software or personal data. Its purpose is to prove the full 7-Zip library exposes a format unavailable in the standalone reduced 7za build.

Archive tests generate their other input/output files in dedicated temporary build directories. The fixture itself and its original text may be used under the repository MIT license.

gbk.zip, big5.zip and shiftjis.zip are original fixtures generated by native/tools/generate-codepage-fixtures.py using Python's ZIP writer, replacing equal-length ASCII filename bytes in local/central headers with the respective encoding and leaving the UTF-8 flag clear. Only the original REAzip test text is stored. Names are 中文.txt, 繁體中文.txt and 日本語.txt. escape.zip and symlink.zip are original ZIPs containing only a traversal filename or Unix symlink metadata for isolated refusal tests; they do not include third-party programs.

RAR fixtures are decoded from the uuencoded fixtures in libarchive v3.8.1's libarchive/test directory. libarchive-LICENSE.txt retains its license. Source: https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/v3.8.1/libarchive/test . test_read_format_rar.rar SHA256 d421b86f6290aefad61b2a36737253b2b30fe27c156bd95abfc230f24fe0307e; test_read_format_rar5_stored.rar SHA256 35d75e315d164d2e329afc28f7d844f013271b4fcffd4ddd78efcdd114a383a7. No RAR encoder is included or invoked at runtime. The WIM fixture is generated by the full 7-Zip library from the original four-byte test text during the read test.
